freeze: Commit before implementation; both cohorts become inspected when evaluated.
question: Can one persistent, feature-schema-agnostic outcome learner acquire skills in a new independently coded transition family from observed effects and retain its earlier learned families, without receiving a family label or privileged action meanings?

simulators.name: quarry
simulators.physics: progress if grade>=moisture+3; damage if moisture>=grade+3; otherwise neutral

simulators.name: coolant
simulators.physics: progress if flow>=5 and seal>=5 and heat<=5; damage if heat>=7 and seal<=3; otherwise neutral

simulators.name: relay
simulators.physics: progress if phase%3==pulse%3 and shield>=noise; damage if pulse>=7 and shield<noise; otherwise neutral

features: Each action reveals only its own integer 0..9 readings under previously unknown string keys and a per-episode opaque random ID; the learner is given neither simulator family name nor hidden rule. A shared public progress/damage outcome is computed from after-before sensors. Feature names are engineered observation vocabulary and make schema identification possible; the tasks share a developer-written interface and objectives.
training_actor: Independent seeded random actor executes ONE first action in each disposable simulated episode; action consequences may be harmful and must be reported. No learner actions to collect training data.
schema_memory: Persistent capacity<=1000, learns 5-nearest-neighbor observed outcome conditional on EXACT discovered feature-key signature. Standard Euclidean squared numeric distance; unknown signatures return priors (no action names). Records all ordered validated public outcomes, integrity-checked versioned replay.
target_only: Relearn only from relay target events, excluding original quarry/coolant knowledge.
recent_48: Only latest 48 events across all environments.
source_frozen: Quarry/coolant training only, no relay feedback.
outcome_scoring: Choose action with maximal 3*estimated_progress -10*estimated_damage. Equal scores broken by opaque handle ID. Unknown schema has score 0, i.e. deterministic but uninformed; this is not safe abstention.
acceptance: Relay learning should measurably improve from zero-target-observation checkpoint relative to frozen source and untrained random, and quarry/coolant revisit should remain comparable to their pre-relay performance, without misrepresenting zero-shot transfer.
nonclaims: The three physical rules, numbers and synthetic feature names are authored by the same development effort; not independently administered holdout.
Known numeric values are privileged engineering affordance descriptors, not inferred real-world physics.
Exact feature-key gating is a handcrafted inductive bias; no semantic alignment across vocabularies is learned.
Target feedback required, so good relay performance is adaptation, not zero-shot generalization.
An independent simulator actor incurs real simulated harm; no safe causal exploration is shown.
Cryptographic hashes provide internal replay, not source authentication.
The data are simulation-only with no AthenZ or Synveil integration and no action authority.
preserve: existing NumericOutcomeMemory and optional retrieval learner unchanged
